result:
I merged the latest master into PR #172 and pushed it. It's now waiting on CI for the new head, `14ee03e4a8`.

- **Why the last attempt stopped:** the lane work was already done. The PR was marked ready and the audit found no high or medium issues. The fold job turned it down only because its `check` run was older than master's current head. My local worktree was also 238 commits behind its own branch on the remote, so I caught it up first.
- **What changed:** `git merge origin/master` merged cleanly and brought in 5 commits (PRs #214 and #179). I added an "Attempt 2" section to `docs/lanes/clrpad164/NOTES.md` saying why the previous attempt didn't finish. `preflight.sh --allow-tracker` passes. The code, prediction and measurements are unchanged.
- **PR state:** ready, not draft. Its labels are still `needs-rebase` and `verified`.
- **Still to do:** once CI is green on `14ee03e4a8`, the handback says to run `gh-label.sh rm 172 needs-rebase` and `gh-label.sh add 172 fold-ready`. I couldn't run those this session because CI hadn't finished. I posted a `[lane.clrpad164] waiting:` comment on the PR saying this.
- **Files: line:** the PR body's `Files:` doesn't list the two `docs/audits/…clrpad164-pass1` files that the audit added to the branch. I left the body as it was.
- **Caveat on `verified`:** as NOTES.md already says, the device arm can't see this change because it sits inside `#ifndef __ANDROID__`. So `verified` means only that the control legs passed. Testing the fix itself still needs a run on the desktop OpenGL renderer.

The Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings before they can be used. This task didn't need them.
